natural: Disabled in body, firm in will

meaning.en: Physically disabled but strong-willed.
meaning.zh: 身体残疾，但意志坚强。

examples.zh: 这位身残志坚的运动员获得了金牌。
examples.en: The athlete, unbowed by disability, won gold.

examples.zh: 他身残志坚，自学成才。
examples.en: Disabled but determined, he taught himself and succeeded.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Common in news and tributes.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，新闻和表彰中常用。

natural: Stones bursting and heaven astonished

meaning.en: Earth-shattering; astonishingly original.
meaning.zh: 原形容箜篌的声音忽而高亢，忽而低沉，出人意外。后多比喻文章议论新奇惊人。

examples.zh: 这一发现石破天惊，震动了科学界。
examples.en: The discovery was earth-shattering and rocked the scientific world.

examples.zh: 他提出了一个石破天惊的观点。
examples.en: He put forward a startlingly original view.

story.en: Li He described a harpist's playing: "Where Nüwa smelted stones to mend the sky, the stones burst, heaven is startled, and autumn rain pours down" (石破天惊逗秋雨).
story.zh: 李贺《李凭箜篌引》："女娲炼石补天处，石破天惊逗秋雨。"

usage.en: Attributive or predicate.

pinyin: sī mǎ zhāo zhī xīn —— lù rén jiē zhī
literal: Sima Zhao · 's · heart — passers-by · all · know
natural: Sima Zhao's ambition — every passer-by knows it

meaning.en: A scheme so obvious that everyone sees through it.
meaning.zh: 比喻野心非常明显，人人都知道。

equivalents: everyone can see what he's up to

examples.zh: 他想当经理的野心，真是司马昭之心——路人皆知。
examples.en: His ambition to be manager is an open secret.

examples.zh: 对方的意图是司马昭之心，大家都看得出来。
examples.en: The other side's intentions are as plain as day.

origin.source: 《三国志·魏书·三少帝纪》裴松之注引《汉晋春秋》

story.en: The young Wei emperor Cao Mao, a puppet of the regent Sima Zhao, said in fury: "Sima Zhao's intentions are known to every passer-by!" He led a doomed attack on Sima and was killed. The account is quoted by Pei Songzhi from Xi Zuochi's Han Jin Chunqiu.
story.zh: 魏帝曹髦被司马昭架空，愤然说：“司马昭之心，路人所知也！”随后率众讨伐，被杀。此事为裴松之注引习凿齿《汉晋春秋》所载。

usage.en: The first half alone is common: 这是司马昭之心.

natural: Pine and cypress are last to wither

meaning.en: True integrity shows in hard times.
meaning.zh: 比喻有道德的人在艰难环境中仍能坚守节操。

examples.zh: 老师常说“松柏后凋”，越是艰难越要守住本心。
examples.en: Our teacher often said that pines are the last to wither: the harder things get, the more we must hold to our principles.

examples.zh: 危难中他坚守岗位，有松柏后凋的品格。
examples.en: He held his post in the crisis, steadfast like the evergreen pine.

story.en: Confucius: "Only when the year grows cold do we know that the pine and cypress are the last to wither."
story.zh: 《论语·子罕》："岁寒，然后知松柏之后凋也。"

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.

synonyms: 疾风知劲草，烈火见真金

natural: A tortoise pulling its head in

meaning.en: A coward who hides from trouble.
meaning.zh: 比喻胆小怕事、遇事退缩的人。

equivalents: hide one's head in the sand

examples.zh: 出了问题他就当缩头乌龟，什么都不管。
examples.en: When there's trouble he hides like a coward and does nothing.

examples.zh: 别做缩头乌龟，勇敢面对吧。
examples.en: Don't be a chicken — face it.

usage.en: Object, often 当/做缩头乌龟. Insulting.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说"当缩头乌龟"。骂人语。

natural: Sun Kang reading by snowlight

meaning.en: Studying diligently despite poverty.
meaning.zh: 形容家境贫寒，刻苦读书。

examples.zh: 孙康映雪的故事激励了无数学子。
examples.en: The story of Sun Kang reading by snowlight has inspired countless students.

examples.zh: 他家里穷，却有孙康映雪的精神。
examples.en: His family was poor, but he studied with Sun Kang's dedication.

story.en: Sun Kang of Jin was too poor for lamp oil, so on winter nights he read by the light reflected from the snow.
story.zh: 晋代孙康家贫无油点灯，冬夜常借雪的反光读书。

date.zh: 唐 · 约726年（《初学记》成书）
date.en: Tang dynasty, c. 726 (compilation of Chuxueji, which quotes it)

usage.en: Subject or attributive. Often paired with 车胤囊萤.
usage.zh: 多作主语、定语，常与"车胤囊萤"并提。

natural: Adding troops while reducing cooking fires

meaning.en: To feign weakness to lure the enemy.
meaning.zh: 比喻迷惑敌人，伪装示弱。

equivalents: lull the enemy into false confidence

examples.zh: 孙膑添兵减灶，诱敌深入。
examples.en: Sun Bin reduced his cooking fires to lure the enemy in.

examples.zh: 谈判时他添兵减灶，故意示弱。
examples.en: In negotiations he deliberately feigned weakness.

story.en: Pursued by Wei, Sun Bin had Qi's army cut its camp fires from 100,000 to 50,000 to 30,000 on successive days. Pang Juan thought the men were deserting, rushed ahead with light troops, and was ambushed at Maling. The story is in the Shiji; the four-character form 添兵减灶 is a later wording.
story.zh: 魏军追击齐军，孙膑令齐军逐日减少军灶，由十万灶减到五万、三万灶。庞涓以为齐军大批逃亡，轻兵追赶，在马陵中伏。故事载于《史记》，“添兵减灶”这一四字形式是后起的。

usage.en: Predicate.

natural: Spitting out food and holding one's hair

meaning.en: (Of a leader) eager to welcome talented people.
meaning.zh: 形容求贤心切，礼贤下士。

examples.zh: 周公吐哺握发，天下归心。
examples.en: The Duke of Zhou dropped everything to welcome talent, and the realm gave him its heart.

examples.zh: 这位校长吐哺握发，广纳贤才。
examples.en: The principal was eager to recruit talent from everywhere.

story.en: The Duke of Zhou said that to greet visiting scholars he would interrupt his bath three times, holding his wet hair, and spit out his food three times at a meal.
story.zh: 周公说："我一沐三握发，一饭三吐哺，起以待士，犹恐失天下之贤人。"

usage.en: Predicate. 发 is fà.

natural: Poisoning living beings

meaning.en: To inflict cruelty and suffering on the people.
meaning.zh: 指残害人民。

examples.zh: 侵略者烧杀抢掠，荼毒生灵。
examples.en: The invaders burned, killed and looted, inflicting untold suffering.

examples.zh: 暴君荼毒生灵，终被推翻。
examples.en: The tyrant brutalised his people and was eventually overthrown.

usage.en: Predicate. 荼 is tú.

natural: Dropping one's chopsticks at a thunderclap

meaning.en: To hide one's true feelings by feigning fright.
meaning.zh: 借故掩饰内心的惊慌。

examples.zh: 他被问得心慌，只好学刘备闻雷失箸，借故掩饰。
examples.en: Liu Bei dropped his chopsticks at the thunder and cleverly hid his true feelings.

examples.zh: 他的慌张被问到时，假装闻雷失箸。
examples.en: When questioned, he covered his panic with a convenient excuse.

story.en: Cao Cao told Liu Bei over wine: "The only heroes in the world are you and I." Startled, Liu Bei dropped his chopsticks — then blamed a clap of thunder, hiding his ambition.
story.zh: 曹操对刘备说："今天下英雄，惟使君与操耳。"刘备吃惊失箸，借打雷掩饰过去。

usage.en: Subject or predicate. From the famous "discussing heroes over wine" scene.
usage.zh: 多作主语、谓语。出自"煮酒论英雄"。

natural: Literary ideas gushing like a spring

meaning.en: Ideas flowing freely in writing.
meaning.zh: 写文章的思路像泉水一样涌出来。形容文思敏捷。

examples.zh: 一坐到书桌前，他就文思泉涌。
examples.en: As soon as he sits at his desk, the ideas pour out.

examples.zh: 今天文思泉涌，一口气写了五千字。
examples.en: I was really inspired today and wrote five thousand words in one go.

usage.en: Predicate.

natural: Not one escaped

meaning.en: No one escaped; all affected.
meaning.zh: 没有一个能幸运地避免。

examples.zh: 这场风暴中，村里的房屋无一幸免。
examples.en: Not a single house in the village was spared by the storm.

examples.zh: 这次检查，所有部门无一幸免。
examples.en: No department escaped this inspection.

usage.en: Predicate.

natural: The thing is worth what it costs

meaning.en: Good value for money.
meaning.zh: 东西的价值与价格相符。

examples.zh: 这部手机虽然贵，但物有所值。
examples.en: The phone is expensive but worth every penny.

examples.zh: 这次培训物有所值。
examples.en: The course was good value for money.

usage.en: Predicate.

natural: Xi Shi clutching her heart

meaning.en: Beauty that looks lovely even in pain; also clumsy imitation (with 东施效颦).
meaning.zh: 形容美女病态更美。也用以讽刺盲目模仿。

examples.zh: 她病中的样子如西施捧心，惹人怜爱。
examples.en: Even ill, she looked as lovely as Xi Shi clutching her heart.

examples.zh: 西施捧心本是美态，东施效颦却成了笑话。
examples.en: Xi Shi clutching her heart was beautiful; Dong Shi copying it became a joke.

story.en: The great beauty Xi Shi suffered heart pain and frowned, holding her chest — and looked lovelier than ever. Her plain neighbour copied the gesture and frightened everyone away.
story.zh: 西施心痛，捧心皱眉，更加美丽。邻家丑女模仿她，人们见了都躲开。

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪

usage.en: Subject or object. Often paired with 东施效颦.
usage.zh: 多作主语、宾语，常与"东施效颦"并提。

natural: Meticulous to the finest detail

meaning.en: Meticulous down to the smallest detail.
meaning.zh: 非常细致，连很细微的地方都照顾到。

examples.zh: 护士对病人照顾得细致入微。
examples.en: The nurses care for patients down to the smallest detail.

examples.zh: 作家对人物心理的描写细致入微。
examples.en: The author depicts characters' psychology with meticulous detail.

usage.en: Predicate or complement.

natural: Putting brush to paper produces an essay

meaning.en: To write fluently and brilliantly.
meaning.zh: 一动笔就写成文章。形容文思敏捷。

examples.zh: 他才思敏捷，下笔成章。
examples.en: He's quick-witted and writes effortlessly.

examples.zh: 曹植自幼聪慧，下笔成章。
examples.en: Cao Zhi was bright from childhood and wrote brilliantly.

story.en: Cao Zhi told his father Cao Cao, who suspected someone wrote his essays for him: "My words come out as arguments; when I put down my brush it becomes an essay" (言出为论，下笔成章).
story.zh: 曹操怀疑曹植的文章是请人代写，曹植说："言出为论，下笔成章，顾当面试，奈何倩人？"

usage.en: Predicate.

text: 近水楼台先得月，向阳花木易为春
pinyin: jìn shuǐ lóu tái xiān dé yuè, xiàng yáng huā mù yì wéi chūn
literal: near · water · tower · first · get · moon, facing · sun · flowers · trees · easily · become · spring
natural: The waterside tower gets the moon first; sun-facing flowers bloom first

meaning.en: Being close to the source of benefit gives one an advantage.
meaning.zh: 比喻由于地处近便而获得优先的机会。

equivalents: it's not what you know but who you know
the early bird catches the worm

examples.zh: 他在公司总部工作，近水楼台先得月，升职最快。
examples.en: Working at head office gave him the inside track, and he was promoted fastest.

examples.zh: 近水楼台先得月，住在学校旁边上学很方便。
examples.en: Proximity pays — living next to the school makes getting there easy.

story.en: When Fan Zhongyan governed Hangzhou, his officials were all promoted except Su Lin, who was posted away. Su sent a couplet: "The tower by the water gets the moon first; flowers facing the sun easily become spring." Fan took the hint and recommended him.
story.zh: 范仲淹镇守杭州时，身边官员多得提拔，唯苏麟在外未被推荐。苏麟献诗："近水楼台先得月，向阳花木易为春。"范仲淹会意，推荐了他。

usage.en: The first half alone (近水楼台先得月 or just 近水楼台) is far more common.
usage.zh: 多只用前半句，或简说"近水楼台"。

natural: Hearts linked like a rhinoceros horn

meaning.en: Two people instinctively understanding each other.
meaning.zh: 比喻恋爱双方心心相印，也泛指双方对彼此的心思都能心领神会。

examples.zh: 他们俩心有灵犀，一个眼神就明白了。
examples.en: They're on the same wavelength — a glance is enough.

examples.zh: 身无彩凤双飞翼，心有灵犀一点通。
examples.en: Though we lack the phoenix's wings to fly together, our hearts are linked like the rhino's horn.

story.en: Li Shangyin's love poem: "Though we lack the bright phoenix's paired wings, our hearts share the magic rhinoceros horn's single thread" — rhino horn was believed to have a white line linking its two ends.
story.zh: 李商隐《无题》："身无彩凤双飞翼，心有灵犀一点通。"古人认为犀角中有白纹贯通两端。

usage.en: Predicate. Often 心有灵犀一点通.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说"心有灵犀一点通"。

natural: The stars and the great sea

meaning.en: Grand dreams and boundless horizons.
meaning.zh: 比喻远大的理想和广阔的前景。

examples.zh: 我们的征途是星辰大海。
examples.en: Our journey leads to the stars and the sea.

examples.zh: 年轻人应该追求星辰大海。
examples.en: Young people should chase grand dreams.

usage.en: Object. A 21st-century internet-era phrase (from the slogan 我们的征途是星辰大海).
usage.zh: 多作宾语。网络时代流行语，源于"我们的征途是星辰大海"。

natural: What the eye sees is real

meaning.en: Seeing is believing.
meaning.zh: 亲眼看到的才是真实的。

equivalents: I'll believe it when I see it

examples.zh: 耳听为虚，眼见为实。
examples.en: Hearing is unreliable; seeing is believing.

examples.zh: 网上的照片不一定眼见为实。
examples.en: Online photos aren't necessarily what they seem.

usage.en: Usually with 耳听为虚.

natural: Swaying back and forth unsettled

meaning.en: Wavering; undecided.
meaning.zh: 形容意志不坚定，拿不定主意。

examples.zh: 在这个问题上他一直摇摆不定。
examples.en: He's been wavering on this issue.

examples.zh: 摇摆不定的态度让合作伙伴很失望。
examples.en: His vacillating stance disappointed his partners.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.

pinyin: yī rì wéi shī, zhōng shēn wéi fù
literal: one · day · be · teacher, whole · life · be · father
natural: A teacher for a day, a father for life

meaning.en: A teacher deserves lifelong respect, like a parent.
meaning.zh: 即使只当过一天老师，也要终身像对待父亲一样尊敬他。

equivalents: a teacher for a day, a father for life

examples.zh: 一日为师，终身为父，他每年都去看望老师。
examples.en: A teacher for a day is a father for life — he visits his teacher every year.

examples.zh: 中国人讲究一日为师，终身为父。
examples.en: Chinese culture holds that a teacher deserves lifelong respect.

usage.en: Standalone saying. Expresses traditional respect for teachers.
usage.zh: 多单独成句，体现尊师传统。

natural: Taking the blame and reproaching oneself

meaning.en: To take the blame and criticise oneself.
meaning.zh: 主动承担过失并自我谴责。

examples.zh: 事故发生后，厂长引咎自责，主动辞职。
examples.en: After the accident, the factory director took responsibility and resigned.

examples.zh: 领导引咎自责，赢得了大家的尊重。
examples.en: The leader owned up and earned everyone's respect.

usage.en: Predicate. Formal; news and official contexts.

antonyms: 猪八戒耍把式——倒打一耙
朕非亡国之君，诸臣尽是亡国之臣

natural: Courage to spare for sale

meaning.en: Still having energy to spare after a fight.
meaning.zh: 还有剩余的勇气可以使出来。

equivalents: still have plenty left in the tank

examples.zh: 打完上半场，球队依然余勇可贾。
examples.en: After the first half, the team still had plenty left in the tank.

examples.zh: 他连胜三局，仍余勇可贾。
examples.en: After three straight wins he's still raring to go.

story.en: At the Battle of An, the Qi officer Gao Gu, after a successful raid, shouted: "Anyone who wants courage can buy my leftover courage!" (欲勇者，贾余馀勇).
story.zh: 鞌之战中，齐国高固冲入晋军后返回，喊道："欲勇者，贾余馀勇！"

usage.en: Predicate. 贾 is gǔ (sell), not jiǎ.
